verdict.rationale: Lithic's Authorization Rules engine lets users define rules on attributes like MCC, country, currency, and risk score at program/account/card level that automatically trigger approve/decline actions on transaction events, with shadow mode and backtesting to validate before going live, and Auth Stream Access/Events/webhooks provide event-driven automation hooks. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of rule-triggered actions beyond vendor docs, and no evidence of arbitrary custom actions beyond approve/decline/spend-limit style decisions.
